description:
Read remaining prepaid Ready Check credit for a key, in US dollars. This does not run a check and does not charge check credit.

When to use: after paying for a pack (poll until credit appears, usually within seconds of payment confirmation); before a check; or after an insufficient_credit error. Reuse the same key for every check and later packs. Unused credit never expires while the key stays open.

A prepaid key is required (READY_CHECK_KEY, or the key argument). Prefer the environment variable so the key is not placed in the conversation. Never log, email, or share the key.

key.description: Prepaid key (rc_ + 43 URL-safe base64 characters). Prefer the READY_CHECK_KEY environment variable so the key is not placed in the conversation. Never log or share this value.
